title: Decision board used to authorize a broader change than the packet supports
simulated_faults: board records a narrow process or trim decision, but the change ticket promotes lifecycle state or public claims beyond that decision
ticket lacks rollback owner, rollback trigger, or public claim ceiling while still updating service lifecycle or public-summary posture

expected_blocks.expected_failure: change ticket cannot authorize lifecycle, public-summary, schema, validator, or closeout changes broader than the decision board supports
rollback owner, rollback trigger, and public claim ceiling are required before a packet decision becomes a concrete service change
